title: Satyadev Bharti v. State of U.P. and 2 Others
court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
coram: Manoj Kumar Gupta, J.; Vikram D. Chauhan, J.
disposition: Writ disposed; fresh Supply Code order after hearing.
headnote: Where the licensee withdraws a recovery notice founded on a final assessment in an electricity-theft case and undertakes to pass a fresh order after hearing, the writ is disposed of with liberty to pass that order strictly in accordance with the procedure prescribed under the Electricity Supply Code, 2005.
facts: Satyadev Bharti challenged, before the High Court of Judicature at Allahabad, a recovery notice issued by respondent no. 3. The notice was founded on an order of final assessment in a case of theft of electricity. At the hearing, counsel for the Electricity Department told the Court that the impugned recovery had already been withdrawn, and that the Department would pass a fresh order only after giving the petitioner an opportunity of hearing.

holding_units.topic: Fresh order after withdrawal of theft-assessment recovery
holding_units.holding: Once the licensee withdraws the recovery notice issued on a final assessment in an electricity-theft case and states that a fresh order will be passed after hearing, the writ is disposed of with liberty to the respondents to pass that fresh order strictly in accordance with the procedure prescribed under the Electricity Supply Code, 2005.

principle_tags.application: The Court accepted the Electricity Department's withdrawal of the theft-assessment recovery and closed the writ, leaving the Department at liberty to pass a fresh order after hearing, strictly under the procedure prescribed by the Electricity Supply Code, 2005.

not_decided.point: Whether the final assessment of electricity theft, and the recovery raised on it, were sustainable on merits
not_decided.note: The impugned recovery was withdrawn by the Department. The Court did not examine the assessment and left a fresh order, after hearing, to the respondents.
